newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Stork sees higher full-year 1996 net.
newsitem.headline: Stork sees higher full-year 1996 net.

text.p: Industrial systems and services group Stork NV reiterated on Wednesday that it expected full-year 1996 net profit to exceed the 1995 figure.
"In line with our previous statements, we expect an improvement of full-year 1996 net profit compared with 1995," the company said.
Stork said the recently acquired aircraft maintenance business Fokker Aviation would contribute to profits in 1996.
Both elements of the forecast reiterated statements made by the company in March and July respectively.
In 1995 Stork's full-year net profit rose 33 percent to 108.3 million guilders.
